method.source_scope: Synthetic BMW demonstration, all eligible household vehicle decision makers, independent waves; not actual BMW findings or population inference. No application code, pack validate_pack.py or published reference results read by this calculation.
method.selected: Binary code 1. Code 0 is an answered nonselection; blank is not asked, never recoded as zero for a base. Unknown binary/weight values cause refusal.
method.weights: Raw weight as supplied, finite and strictly positive; unweighted uses unit weights. Kish n_eff=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2) on each stated base.
method.association: 100*sum(w*I(aware=1 and association=1))/sum(w*I(aware=1)); structural blanks for unaware excluded. All aware respondents must have 0/1 responses.
method.category_average: Arithmetic mean of the ten brand-specific aware-base percentages; each brand exactly once. Also supplies separate nine-brand average excluding BMW, as the guide describes; it is not substituted for requested all-brand average.
method.association_shares: Per attribute and brand: selected weighted count / sum selected counts over brands, and separately aware-base score / sum aware-base scores over brands. Per attribute global link share: attribute selected counts / all attribute-brand selected counts. These distinct definitions are labelled, not conflated.
method.ca: Weighted selected association-count matrix N (brand rows, attribute columns). P=N/sum(N), r=P1,c=P^T1; S=Dr^(-1/2)(P-rc^T)Dc^(-1/2)=U diag(s) V^T. Row principal=Dr^(-1/2)U diag(s); column principal=Dc^(-1/2)V diag(s). Axis inertia=s^2, share=s^2/sum(s^2). First two axes; signs flipped jointly so BMW row coordinates are positive. No row-percentage input or continuity correction. Axes are exploratory; no causal inference.
method.conversion: For consecutive aware->consider->shortlist->firstchoice: sum(w*I(earlier=1 AND later=1))/sum(w*I(earlier=1)). Also raw/weighted count later=1 AND earlier=0. Cross-sectional conditional rates, not matched-person longitudinal conversion.
method.moments: Number of the 12 CEPs linked to brand per respondent. Mean over all eligible; reach=share with >=1 link; mean among linkers; share of links=sum(w*number)/sum over all brands. None/Other and personal relevance flags are outside the twelve brand-specific moment links.
method.recall: Per moment-brand: 100*sum(w*I(link=1 AND aware=1))/sum(w*I(aware=1)). Resolved awareness must include all spontaneous/CEP recalls; asserts no links among unaware, so changing base does not change numerator in this pack.
method.z_test: Independent-wave pooled two-proportion z approximation. p1,p2 weighted rates; n1,n2 Kish effective bases. pooled=(n1*p1+n2*p2)/(n1+n2); SE=sqrt(pooled*(1-pooled)*(1/n1+1/n2)); z=(p2-p1)/SE; p_two_sided=erfc(abs(z)/sqrt(2)). Raw unweighted version also supplied. Not a complex-survey variance estimator; no multiplicity adjustment; 5% flags are unadjusted.
method.zero_denominator: null with zero base, never substituted zero. Values retained at floating-point full precision.
